# ISummerVestingWalletFactoryV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerVestingWalletFactoryV2.sol)

**Title:**
ISummerVestingWalletFactoryV2

Interface for the factory that deploys SummerVestingWalletV2 instances and tracks their owners


## Functions
### createVestingWallet

MUTATIVE FUNCTIONS           ///

Creates a new vesting wallet for a beneficiary


```solidity
function createVestingWallet(
    address beneficiary,
    ISummerVestingWalletV2.VestingParams memory vestingParams,
    ISummerVestingWalletV2.PerformanceGoal[] memory performanceGoals
)
    external
    returns (address newVestingWallet);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`beneficiary`|`address`|Address of the beneficiary|
|`vestingParams`|`ISummerVestingWalletV2.VestingParams`|The vesting parameters|
|`performanceGoals`|`ISummerVestingWalletV2.PerformanceGoal[]`|Initial performance goals|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newVestingWallet`|`address`|The address of the created vesting wallet|

## Events
### VestingWalletCreated
EVENTS                 ///

Emitted when a new vesting wallet is created


```solidity
event VestingWalletCreated(
    address indexed beneficiary,
    address indexed vestingWallet,
    ISummerVestingWalletV2.VestingParams vestingParams,
    uint256 performanceGoalsCount
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`beneficiary`|`address`|The address of the beneficiary|
|`vestingWallet`|`address`|The address of the created vesting wallet|
|`vestingParams`|`ISummerVestingWalletV2.VestingParams`|The vesting parameters|
|`performanceGoalsCount`|`uint256`|The number of initial performance goals|

## Errors
### ZeroTokenAddress
ERRORS                 ///

Thrown when zero token address is provided


```solidity
error ZeroTokenAddress();
```

### InsufficientAllowance
Thrown when insufficient allowance for token transfer


```solidity
error InsufficientAllowance(uint256 required, uint256 actual);
```

### InsufficientBalance
Thrown when insufficient balance for token transfer


```solidity
error InsufficientBalance(uint256 required, uint256 actual);
```

### TransferAmountMismatch
Thrown when transfer amount doesn't match expected


```solidity
error TransferAmountMismatch(uint256 expected, uint256 actual);
```

### VestingWalletAlreadyExists
Thrown when vesting wallet already exists for beneficiary


```solidity
error VestingWalletAlreadyExists(address beneficiary);
```
